verdict.rationale: AWS publishes official getting-started material, including recommended onboarding tasks, an Amplify tutorial that builds and deploys a React app, a simple website-hosting tutorial, and CLI install docs. That covers the core idea of official quickstarts from zero to a deployed service. However, the evidence never shows the exact commands in those quickstarts or any claim that a first deploy takes under an hour. Missing for 10: evidence of copy-paste command sequences in the quickstarts, a documented or independently corroborated time-to-first-deploy under an hour, hands-on reports of completing a quickstart.
